description: Dependency updates for Hearth (BUILD-PLAN C0.1, TECH-SPEC). Nothing merges automatically: every update goes through CI, CodeRabbit and Qodo like any PR (CLAUDE.md, Git). minimumReleaseAge also holds the weekly lockfile refresh to 7 days (Renovate runs npm with --before) while every pinned version is at least that old; when one is younger, Renovate drops the hold and says so in the PR, which then isn't merged (CLAUDE.md, Testing and CI). Security fixes skip the wait.

customManagers.description: The gitleaks version that secrets.yml installs through the Go module proxy.

packageRules.description: Node stays on 24 LTS (T2, D37): moving to the next LTS is a decision, not an update.
Postgres stays on 17 (T3). The pg17 tag already follows the newest pgvector build for 17.
Vite is pinned in the root, apps/web and demo/ so they share one copy; update them together.
React and its types move together, in apps/web and demo/ alike, so npm keeps one copy (T21).
TanStack Router and Query in apps/web: the router's packages are released together (T21).
Playwright and its axe integration, in apps/web and demo/. A new browser build can change how pages render, so the visual baselines are re-adopted from this PR's check artifact (T21).
Tailwind and its Vite plugin, in apps/web and demo/ (T21).
The self-hosted fonts in apps/web. A font change moves text in every screenshot, so the visual baselines are re-adopted from this PR's check artifact (T21).
lucide-react is pinned in apps/web and demo/ so they share one copy; update both together.
